from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_CEILING
import hashlib, json, re
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit')
source = (root / 'raw/director-getting-paid.html').read_bytes()
model = json.loads((root / 'director-one-time-fee-model.json').read_text())
class VisibleText(HTMLParser):
    hidden = 0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in {'script', 'style'}:
            self.hidden += 1
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'script', 'style'}:
            self.hidden -= 1
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.hidden:
            parts.append(data)
parts = []
VisibleText().feed(source.decode('utf-8'))
text = ' '.join(' '.join(parts).split())
pattern = r'minimum.{0,35}(?:threshold|payout)|threshold.{0,60}|bank payouts will be made in USD|hold(?:ing)? period|\b(?:1-5|1–5) days\b|verify your identity'
passages = list(dict.fromkeys(text[max(0,m.start()-70):m.end()+95] for m in re.finditer(pattern,text,re.I)))[:12]
threshold_match = re.search(r'minimum (?:payout )?threshold of\s*\$\s*(\d+(?:\.\d{2})?)', text, re.I)
usd_bank = bool(re.search(r'bank payouts will be made in USD', text, re.I))
scenarios = []
if threshold_match and usd_bank:
    threshold = Decimal(threshold_match.group(1))
    for row in model['rows']:
        if Decimal(row['price_usd']) != 15:
            continue
        net = Decimal(row['remaining_before_payout_usd'])
        sales = int((threshold / net).to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING))
        balance = net * sales
        fee = (balance * Decimal('0.01')).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        scenarios.append({'scenario':row['scenario'],'sales':sales,'balance_usd':str(balance),'modeled_fee_usd':str(fee),'modeled_after_fee_usd':str(balance-fee)})
result = {'source':'https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/getting-started/getting-paid','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'platform_fee_source_sha256':model['source_sha256'],'observed_passages':passages,'threshold_quote':threshold_match.group() if threshold_match else None,'usd_bank_wording_found':usd_bank,'conditional_scenarios':scenarios,'limits':'The calculation interprets the documented dollar threshold in USD for the stated USD bank route. It assumes zero opening balance, hypothetical eligible USD 15 sales and applicability of the separately documented 1% non-US bank payout charge. Activation, exact-archive rights, conversion, taxes, refunds, operating costs and settlement remain unverified. Empty scenarios mean the wording check did not support automatic calculation.'}
output = root / 'director-payout-source-readback.json'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
